bot-list.delete-description: Are you sure you want to delete this bot? This action cannot be undone. All chats and settings will be permanently removed from the service.

register-bot.token-invalid: Invalid token. Please check your token and try again.

product-list.delete-description: Are you sure you want to delete this product? This action cannot be undone.

product-edit.title: Edit product
product-edit.description: Please provide the product information below. This information will be used to generate responses and create an offer.
product-edit.name-description: The product name displayed to the user
product-edit.image-description: The product image displayed to the user
product-edit.description-description: The product description shown to the user and used by AI
product-edit.price-description: The product price in the selected currency
product-edit.pay-description: The product payment link shown to the user
product-edit.use-invoice-description: Choose which payment method will be used to pay for the product, by link or inside Telegram
product-edit.payment-token-description: The payment system token used to receive payments inside Telegram, you can get it in the payment system settings

bot-actions.status-description: You can activate or deactivate the bot
bot-actions.delete-description: You can delete the bot and all its data, including the token
bot-actions.delete-dialog-description: Are you sure you want to delete this bot? This action cannot be undone. All chats and settings will be permanently removed from the service.

bot-params.preset-description: Select the main instruction set for the bot
bot-params.instructions-description: For the bot to work correctly, you need to provide instructions. They will be used to generate responses. The more precise and detailed they are, the better.

bot-register.title: Connect bot
bot-register.description: A bot token is required to connect a new bot to your account. You can get it in Telegram by following the link
bot-register.token-invalid: Invalid token. Please check your token and try again.

bot-statistics.note: In this section you can view bot statistics for the selected time period.
bot-statistics.messages-description: The number of messages sent by the bot during the selected period across all conversations
bot-statistics.chats-description: The number of new chats created by users during the selected period
bot-statistics.payments-description: The number of clicks on payment links during the selected period

browser.title: Open this app in Telegram
browser.body: This app must be opened inside Telegram (as a Mini App). It will not work in a regular browser.
